answer: Each fake identity must string one jade bead onto its own thread of a comet's tail, paying the k-th partition number of knots: 1, 2, 3, 5, 7. N fakes cost 138 knots for 10 and 1.6 billion for 100, since each new thread must be knotted in every unordered split. If two beads share one thread, the knots slip and both beads fall off the tail, so sharing never saves a knot.
